newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zairean president, prime minister meet in France.
newsitem.headline: Zairean president, prime minister meet in France.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, recuperating from cancer surgery in southern France, met his prime minister, Kengo wa Dondo, for talks on Saturday at Mobutu's Riviera villa, witnesses said.
The two men met as the international community began to launch a massive humanitarian intervention to help refugees stranded in eastern Zaire by fighting between Tutsi rebels and Zairean troops.

French authorities said Kengo had arrived in the Riviera capital Nice on Saturday morning from Brussels for his talks with Mobutu. The United Nations approved dispatching a multinational force to Zaire to help refugees late on Friday.
Kengo arrived in nearby Roquebrune and entered Mobutu's palatial villa at about 11.30 a.m. (1030 GMT), the witnesses said.
Mobutu has been keeping a low profile in France since his arrival on November 4 after treatment for prostate cancer in Switzerland.
Aides have said he planned soon to return to Zaire, but he has appeared weak and thin during his few public appearances.
He has however, held talks during his convalescence with United Nations envoy Raymond Chretien, Congo President Pascal Lissouba and South African Vice President Thabo Mbeki.
